title: Copilot Studio: agent node runs an AI agent as a workflow step
summary: The briefing's roadmap facts, billing statements and governance claims are supported. Two minor corrections would make the credit-allocation instructions clearer: complete the UI route and move the request-body description out of the API call.

claims.claim: An agent node can reason, call tools and read knowledge before returning a result within a workflow.

claims.quote: The agent response then becomes available as dynamic content that you can use in any subsequent step.

claims.claim: New agent for this workflow defines an inline agent and its instructions inside the node.

- Connectors: Any Power Platform connector action.
